description: Delete one of the user's Sightglass boards and everything saved on it. This cannot be undone, so only call it when the user asked for this board to be deleted. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where a saved asset or new file lands. Its workspace's access applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's access applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_delete_board
title: Delete board
